question: Under identical ecological fitness and turnover laws and matched total standing plant food (~64k EU), does a sustained regional productivity gradient (West Deforest 0.30, East AddNutrient 1.00) increase population body-mass variance (live.trait_mass_var) and differentiate West/East regional mean mass relative to a total-matched uniform-scarcity control arm (live.resource_capacity_scale = 0.42 + whole-map AddNutrient 1.00)?
model_status: headless adapter verified; NOT a live-world experiment-ready claim

design_confound_resolution.why_equal_total_by_east_boost_is_impossi: ResourceField::from_biomes initializes every cell at capacity r = r_max (153,587.25 EU total: West 88,757.75 EU, East 64,829.50 EU) and fertilise_region (core/live_experiment.rs:1263) clamps each cell at r_max. Stripping West without editing src-tauri/src necessarily lowers total standing crop (-52.47% post-warmup in smoke).
design_confound_resolution.scarcity_arm_analytic_derivation: Analytic East_capacity / Total_capacity = 64829.499945282936 / 153587.24986362457 = 0.422102, rounded to two decimals -> live.resource_capacity_scale = 0.42 (initial biomass/capacity = 64,506.64 EU, initial detritus = 89,080.61 EU, identical closed-EU total = 153,587.25 EU; uniform West/East ratio 0.42x). Chosen in Fix Round 1 after observing the round-0 smoke standing-crop (~64.1k vs ~134.9k EU) and agent-count (99 vs 13) observations disclosed in the round-0 verdict, with zero body-mass values ever seen or consulted (body_mass_consulted = false).
design_confound_resolution.why_uniform_whole_map_add_nutrient: Motivated in Fix Round 1 by round-0 smoke demographic agent counts (control_uniform fell to 13 at T without nutrient refill vs 99 in treatment_gradient; zero body-mass values consulted): AddNutrient 1.00 over Rect{0,0,255,255} gives control_uniform_scarcity the same detritus->plants grazing-refill loop as treatment_gradient's East AddNutrient 1.00 while maintaining uniform spatial carrying capacity. In headless smoke, live.standing_crop mismatch is -0.44% post-warmup ((T - S)/T = -280.49 / 64,098.52 EU = -0.4376%, matching smoke-report.json scarcity_vs_treat_post_warmup_relative_mismatch; (T - S)/S = -0.4357%, also -0.44%), -1.86% at T = 18000 ((T - S)/S: 63,282.05 vs 64,483.46 EU; delta -1,201.41 EU), and -1.68% over the 14400..=18000 tail window ((T - S)/S: 63,381.92 vs 64,467.85 EU; delta -1,085.93 EU), all inside the +/- 10% b2 gate.
design_confound_resolution.primary_contrast: treatment_gradient - control_uniform_scarcity (isolates the spatial gradient at matched ~64k EU total standing crop)
secondary_contrasts: control_uniform_scarcity - control_uniform (uniform scarcity plus whole-map AddNutrient refill; control_uniform has none)
design_confound_resolution.additive_decomposition: (T - U) == (T - S) + (S - U) per seed, reported on the subset of seeds valid in all three arms (control_uniform, control_uniform_scarcity, and treatment_gradient)
design_confound_resolution.residual_limitation_stated_in_advance: treatment_gradient holds West down via recurring Deforest 0.30 while control_uniform_scarcity scales r_max uniformly at genesis via resource_capacity_scale = 0.42; until a regional r_max intervention kind exists, ongoing West stripping vs genesis r_max scaling remains an acknowledged mechanistic difference.

hypotheses.bessel_sensitivity_analysis: Compute var * n / (n - 1) using live.agent_count at T = 18000 over the exact same valid n >= 2 pairs as H1 (live.trait_mass_var divides by n, so smaller S population sizes ~9-12 vs 37-99 in T introduce ~+8% finite-sample bias in H1's predicted direction); evaluate under the same thresholds and report live.agent_count at T per arm with population size identified as an ecological mediator of the gradient.
hypotheses.rationale: Primary dispersion test at T: under matched total standing plant food (~64k EU), the spatial productivity gradient increases population body-mass variance (treatment_gradient - control_uniform_scarcity > 0) under ecological selection.

Card S2 regional means (West columns 0..=127 vs East columns 128..=255), registered before any data to test West/East spatial differentiation at matched total plant food; pairs with an empty West or East half at T are excluded under empty_half_rule.

Demoted before experimental data: live.shannon computes shannon_index([herbivores, predators]) (core/live_experiment.rs:1611-1612), a two-class trophic composition index rather than body-mass or ecological niche diversity. In smoke across all arms, predators went extinct by tick 3600 leaving live.shannon = 0.0 thereafter; reported for completeness only, never interpreted as biological null evidence.

Demoted before experimental data: BevyMapElitesArchive (core/live_experiment.rs:1630-1633) is populated only in the desktop app evolution thread (core/simulation_loop.rs:832). LiveExperimentAdapter inserts an empty archive (core/live_experiment.rs:2893), so live.archive_coverage is permanently 0.0 in every headless sample (60/60 in round 0, 90/90 in round 1); not measurable in this harness and never interpreted as biological null evidence.
Closed-EU conservation check across all three arms.
Verifies both (a) treatment_gradient reduces total standing crop relative to control_uniform and (b) control_uniform_scarcity matches treatment_gradient's total standing crop.

seeds.smoke_seed_exclusion_is_mechanical: 999979 is absent from all three experimental manifests' seed lists, and run_manifest_seed returns RunStatus::Failed{SeedNotInManifest} if asked to run an undeclared seed.

duration.ladder_rule: WP-3 chooses T from this descending ladder once using the WP-2 smoke runtime before any experimental seed runs, and never lowers N.

extinction_rule.definition: live.agent_count == 0 at any sampled tick (600, 1200, ..., 18000) or in final_observables at T = 18000
extinction_rule.why_sentinel_guard_needed: mass_statistics(&[]) returns [0.0; 4] (core/live_experiment.rs:1458-1461) and RunStatus stays Completed, so without an explicit exclusion rule an extinct run injects 0.0 instead of a missing value into paired trait_mass_* statistics.
extinction_rule.handling: Recorded outcome, never Failed; exclusion is per contrast across the three arms — a run with live.agent_count == 0 removes its seed only from the pairwise contrasts whose two arms include that extinct arm (H1 treatment_gradient - control_uniform_scarcity counts only S and T runs; an extinction in control_uniform removes that seed from T - U and S - U only, never from H1). The additive decomposition table (T - U) == (T - S) + (S - U) is reported on the subset of seeds valid in all three arms. All excluded pairs are dropped from live.trait_mass_* paired statistics (H1, H1_tail_window, S1, S2, S3) and logged with seed, arm, contrast, and first extinct tick.
extinction_rule.fewer_than_10_complete_pairs: insufficient_evidence for that contrast; no replacement seeds and N is never changed (at most 2 pairs may be excluded out of 12).

min_agent_count_rule.definition: live.agent_count < 2 in final_observables at T = 18000 (or at any sample in 14400..=18000 for H1_tail_window)
min_agent_count_rule.why_needed: For a 0- or 1-agent population, mass_statistics yields degenerate zero variance and zero p90 - p10 IQR; even 1 survivor does not measure population dispersion.
min_agent_count_rule.handling: Exclusion is per contrast — a singleton run (< 2 agents) removes its seed from H1, H1_tail_window, and S1 only for contrasts that use that arm (H1 counts only S and T runs) and is reported in singleton_table_by_arm; if < 10 valid non-extinct, non-singleton pairs remain in a contrast, that contrast verdict is insufficient_evidence.

empty_half_rule.definition: At T = 18000 (final_observables), live.trait_mass_mean_west == 0.0 || live.trait_mass_mean_east == 0.0 on either of the two arms in the evaluated contrast
empty_half_rule.mechanical_validity_proof: decode_genotype rejects zero-node genotypes (core/spawn.rs:75-78) and every living segment carries positive mass, so AgentGenotype.0.total_mass() is strictly > 0.0; mass_statistics(&[]) returns 0.0 only when a grid half holds 0 living agents (core/live_experiment.rs:1421-1422, 1605-1606).
empty_half_rule.handling: Exclusion is per contrast — a seed with an empty half removes that seed from S3 paired contrast east - west only for contrasts that include that arm, and is recorded with seed, arm, contrast, tick = 18000, and empty half (west | east | both); global H1/S1/S2 remain unaffected unless extinction or min_agent_count_rule also triggered.
empty_half_rule.fewer_than_10_valid_s3_pairs: insufficient_evidence for S3 on that contrast; never replace seeds and never inject 0.0 into S3 deltas.

conditions: ci95 on paired_mean_delta strictly excludes 0 (ci95_low > 0.0 or ci95_high < 0.0)

decision_definitions.null: n_valid_pairs >= 10 AND (ci95 is None OR ci95_low <= 0.0 <= ci95_high)
decision_definitions.between_detectable_below_materiality: n_valid_pairs >= 10 AND ci95 excludes 0 AND (paired_dz is None OR abs(paired_dz) < 0.8 OR abs(paired_mean_delta) < 0.05 * abs(control_mean))
decision_definitions.material_positive: n_valid_pairs >= 10 AND ci95 excludes 0 AND paired_mean_delta > 0.0 AND abs(paired_dz) >= 0.8 AND abs(paired_mean_delta) >= 0.05 * abs(control_mean)
decision_definitions.material_negative_opposite: n_valid_pairs >= 10 AND ci95 excludes 0 AND paired_mean_delta < 0.0 AND abs(paired_dz) >= 0.8 AND abs(paired_mean_delta) >= 0.05 * abs(control_mean)

secondary_endpoints_rule.zero_control_mean_note: For signed contrast S3 (east - west), if control_mean == 0.0 exactly then the relative shift test falls back to ci95 excludes 0 AND abs(paired_dz) >= 0.8 AND abs(paired_mean_delta) > 0.0, annotated explicitly in the report.

thresholds.opposite_direction_rule: material_negative_opposite on H1 is reported as refuting H1 in the opposite direction and is never rebranded as H1 support

analysis_details.h1_primary: live.trait_mass_var read from final_observables at T = 18000 for valid non-extinct, n>=2 pairs on contrast treatment_gradient - control_uniform_scarcity
analysis_details.h1_bessel_sensitivity: Bessel-corrected variance sensitivity analysis: compute var * n / (n - 1) using live.agent_count at T = 18000 over the same valid n >= 2 pairs as H1 and evaluate under the same thresholds; reported alongside H1 without replacing H1
analysis_details.h1_tail_window_formula: Equal-weight arithmetic mean of the 7 sampled ticks in [14400, 18000] inclusive (14400, 15000, 15600, 16200, 16800, 17400, 18000) per seed and arm, then PairedEffect across non-extinct/n>=2 pairs
analysis_details.s1_formula: live.trait_mass_p90 - live.trait_mass_p10 read from final_observables at T = 18000 per seed and arm
analysis_details.s2_formula: live.trait_mass_mean read from final_observables at T = 18000 per seed and arm
analysis_details.s3_formula: (live.trait_mass_mean_east - live.trait_mass_mean_west) read from final_observables at T = 18000 per seed and arm, applying per-contrast empty_half_rule exclusion where either evaluated arm has mean_west == 0.0 or mean_east == 0.0
analysis_details.s6_formula: cumulative per-run sums across all 30 drained sample windows for live.births and live.deaths, plus final-window live.mean_lifespan read from final_observables at T = 18000

reporting.failed_runs: every failed run is reported with its seed, arm, and reason, and excluded per contrast (never silently omitted)

cost.on_budget_exceeded: step down the duration_ticks_ladder in WP-3 from smoke timing before any experimental seed runs; never reduce N

smoke_command: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release --features desktop --example e3_smoke -j 4; then execute src-tauri/target/release/examples/e3_smoke (.exe on Windows) --manifest-dir src-tauri/tests/fixtures/experiments_e3 --out artifacts/experiments/e3-productivity-gradient-body-mass

wp2_smoke_gates.a: ResourceField (256x256) is present in the headless LiveExperimentAdapter world with identical closed EU across all 3 arms
wp2_smoke_gates.b1: West Deforest 0.30 + East AddNutrient 1.00 changes live.standing_crop in treatment_gradient by |rel_shift| >= 0.10 vs control_uniform
wp2_smoke_gates.b2: control_uniform_scarcity (scale = 0.42 + whole-map AddNutrient 1.00) matches treatment_gradient post-warmup mean live.standing_crop within +/- 0.10 with zero Deforest firings
wp2_smoke_gates.c: detritus > 0 before tick 3000 and at tick 3000 in all 3 arms
wp2_smoke_gates.blinding_rule: WP-2 and WP-3 write, print, and gate zero body-mass observable values; only uniform finiteness (is_finite()) is checked over emitted series (body_mass_consulted = false)

execution_host_rule.rule: All 36 E3-X runs (3 arms x 12 seeds) must execute on a single host (identical OS, CPU architecture, and release binary) recorded in E3-X provenance.json, because headless terrain generation is platform-dependent (Windows x86_64 terrain checksum 3152323152 vs macOS arm64 1212187560). If the E3-X execution host OS/arch differs from the smoke host (windows/x86_64), E3-X must re-run e3_smoke once in --release on that execution host first to re-verify WP-2 gates and timing; if any WP-2 gate fails, stop and report; never tune. Before starting every E3-X run and any e3_smoke re-run, the runner must verify and record in provenance that ANIMA_WORLD_ARTIFACT is unset and <temp_dir>/anima_world_artifact.anmw is absent; if either is present, the run must not start (prevents build_live_world -> init_world from silently loading a desktop-app world artifact instead of generated terrain). Because terrain can also be loaded from the terrain cache (ANIMA_CACHE_DIR or <temp_dir>/anima_world_cache) or map_config.json, every E3-X run and the host e3_smoke re-run must record the observed world_identity in provenance.json, and all 36 E3-X runs plus the host e3_smoke re-run must report the exact same observed world_identity; any mismatch stops the campaign immediately (stop and report, never tune).
